svg.title: Edge-connector fingers: hard gold, no mask, a bevel
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Top: plan view of the edge of a board with six gold fingers on a 2.54 mm pitch, 1.5 mm wide and 7 mm long, ending 0.6 mm short of the edge. The solder mask is cleared from the whole finger area and the board corners beside the fingers are chamfered. Bottom: side view of the edge of a 1.6 mm board, beveled at 30 degrees on both faces over the last 0.5 mm, with the gold fingers stopping 0.6 mm from the edge, before the bevel.
